_note: Neon Realtime has no permissions file: read rules are the filters of the server's sealed SQL queries (server/queries.ts), write rules are checks in the server's write handlers (server/mutators.ts), so both count as server, as Convex's function checks do. SQL migrations count as schema; Managed Better Auth's tables are Neon's. scripts/ (db reset, seed, permission checks), neon.ts (config) and harness.mjs are bench plumbing.
